messages.subject: Suppress MS-DOS windows
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm not sure if this is an MplusAutomation or Mplus question, so please bear with me.
I'm running multiple growth mixture models with MplusAutomation with the runModels command. Since it takes quite long to run all my models, I specified PROCESSORS = 4 in my Mplus template file. When I'm running the models, 4 MS-DOS windows will pop up for each model. Considering that it takes multiple days to run all my code and that I still have to do other work on the same computer, this is quite annoying. When I only use on processor, the MS-DOS windows do not pop up, but the code takes a lot longer to run.
Is there a way to suppress the MS-DOS windows?

Best,

Jitske

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Suppress MS-DOS windows
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jitske,

To my knowledge, that is an Mplus thing, not an MplusAutomation thing. I believe it results from Windows not supporting a ‘fork’ mechanism, as is common on *nix-based systems (including Mac). I’m not aware of a way to get those windows not to appear, but you might ask on statmodel.com <http://statmodel.com> if there’s not already something on the discussion boards.

Best,
Michael
